notes.title: Update v1.01
notes.notes:
Hello all, 

It's been a long time coming but here it is. It's a small bug fixes here and there. No major game design changes or anything. 

-All spiders are kill-able with spray.
-Fixed recording 1 & 6 typos.
-Accident achievement fix.
-Fixed ending timer glitch.
-Changed the death screen.

For anything related to our future games/game updates, follow our twitter:
https://twitter.com/ChillasArt

Thanks.
